description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
Do you have a hole in your door at the bottom of the window opening. Well this is the fix.
These are the Suzuki OEM Lock Pull Tab CAPS.
The Lock Pull Tab Caps pop into the upper lock hole located on the top of the door just below the window opening.
This gives you enough to do BOTH door lock holes!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Door Lock Hole CAPS
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
